semantics.AlphaSMS: error 0 means submitted; request_id is submission-level, not per-recipient delivery proof
semantics.GreenWeb: SENT and FAILED are per-recipient submission output; response positions are not request indices
semantics.Pathao: provider-maintained order creation consumer stores returned consignment_id; polling status vocabulary is not verified
semantics.RedX: published Create Parcel returns tracking_id; parcel-info exposes parcel.status but exact polling vocabulary is unresolved
semantics.Steadfast: existing consignment and delivery_status envelope retained; success/state semantics unverified
